summary: v10 items 4+5 done. §4 (cortical-division slivers/triangles): src/components/section/corticalLobes.ts now enforces documented run-quality floors — MIN_DIVISION_RUN_AU = 10 au (own-vertex arc) and MIN_DIVISION_AREA_AU2 = 25 au² (shoelace area of the polygon the canvas fills/strokes), with MIN_DIVISION_LABEL_AREA_AU2 = 25 au² equal to the paint floor so 'painted ⇒ has a label-eligible run' is a theorem; the splitter rotates the closed ring to start at a division change (a wrapped stretch is ONE run, not a head/tail pair), absorbs every sub-threshold span into its neighbour (predecessor, or successor for the span that opens the ring) and iterates to a FIXPOINT because absorption moves the closing chord, and drops a loop that reduces to one sub-threshold span (no neighbour to absorb into; it keeps its context fill).
